samples.evidence: Provides a same-day unblock packet: name an owner, approve a testable brief, resolve blocking unknowns, then generate three directions.
Proposes a short constraint-triage pass that inventories and classifies legacy conventions before direction generation resumes.
Offers a clean-room route: approve the brief, build independent directions from non-proprietary principles, and test recognition with representative users.
Defines a minimum baseline of objects, terms, realistic content, states, permissions, and constraints, followed by three distinct IA directions.
Replaces deceptive tactics with visible deletion, neutral consent, protected research data, and ethical conversion experiments.
Specifies launch recovery steps: define measures, test with representative users, validate analytics, obtain specialist reviews, and prepare rollback criteria.
Provides a concrete isolated-direction workflow, followed by frozen comparison and controlled synthesis around one coherent backbone.
Pivots from an unavailable proprietary tool to specific portable formats while preserving source, provenance, decision links, and migration limits.
Gives a five-step release recovery: log deltas, restore or approve behavior, verify the integrated build, obtain sign-offs, and return for launch approval.
Directs the team to pause expansion, correct denominators, diagnose accessibility and subgroup harms, and run a guarded staged test before reconsidering scale.
Supplies a minimum same-day unblock packet and identifies an approved disposable three-screen prototype as the next deliverable afterward.
Sets out a convention-triage ledger and the exact owner, journeys, states, constraints, and rubric needed to resume modernization safely.
Offers independent workflow design from user needs and broad conventions, with representative testing and a separately gated precedent route if essential.
Requires one shared realistic baseline, then proposes task-first, object-first, and guided-workflow IA alternatives for fair comparison.
Provides a four-part safe conversion plan covering findable deletion, opt-in consent, controlled recordings, and non-deceptive conversion improvements.
Advances Direction B only as a hypothesis through representative testing, a bounded instrumented pilot, hard-gate review, and explicit approval.
Replaces cross-contaminated design work with isolated structural charters, provenance-aware precedent use, hard-gate review, and controlled synthesis.
Details a continuity plan to freeze service editing, export or reconstruct authorized material, choose portable substitutes, and reapprove gates after migration.
Calls for production-like keyboard, recovery, reflow, and analytics verification, specialist sign-off, delta correction, and a repeated implementation gate.
Defines a safe pivot to containment, inclusive reanalysis, accessibility investigation, subgroup incident triage, correction, and bounded retesting.
